visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue NBA-branded baseball cap and a black t-shirt stands outdoors in an urban square at night. The background features the brightly illuminated Taipei 101 skyscraper. He talks directly into the camera with high-energy facial expressions, squinting his eyes and smiling widely. (2) The scene shifts to a modern, brightly lit indoor bar titled 'Lit Lit'. The man sits at the counter, interacting with a male bartender in a vest. Close-ups show a bottle of Glenfiddich whiskey and a garnished cocktail. The lighting is warm and cinematic. (3) The setting changes to an indoor restaurant and bar called 'Beta Bistro'. A female bartender is shown pouring clear liquid into a glass. The man observes and tastes a drink garnished with cucumber slices. The background features shelves of bottles and warm interior lighting. (4) The man is now in 'Bar DUD', a darker lounge environment with neon signs and a stylish aesthetic. He speaks with a male bartender with neck tattoos. Detailed shots show the mixing process, featuring ice and a amber-colored liquid being poured into a small glass. (5) The man returns to a neutral, brightly lit studio-like setting. He stands center-frame, holding a glass and pointing towards the audience. Multiple bottles of Glenfiddich whiskey are displayed prominently in the foreground and on screen graphics. He wears a confident smile.

Speech rate is moderately fast but articulately clear. The BGM ducks slightly to favor dialogue. A 'digital ding' UI sound accompanies a text pop-up. (4) A male voice with professional tone describes drink ingredients. Background noise includes a soft restaurant chatter bed. A percussive 'thud' SFX emphasizes a bottle being placed on a counter. The music maintains a 4/4 electronic rhythm. (5) The speaker concludes with an authoritative, energetic tone. A final 'sparkle' SFX sounds as a brand logo appears on screen. The BGM swells in volume before a sudden hard cut ending. Harmonic tension remains low and resolved.
